identityReview.conclusion: All ten Kili achievement records have no associated quest references. Their miniquest prerequisite reference500 identifies Kili Row and remains a prerequisite, not an identity alias. Their distinct state varbits53743–53752 do not match Kindred Spirits state. Preserve0QP, authored dependencies, wording and chunks (including the suspicious14131). RuneMetrics excludes this lore-completion label already; the fix corrects engine/activity grouping.
